notes.title: Update (190415):
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your playing!

I upgraded this game:
1. The cover image (not very ideal, just a style to try).
2. Added a few background images.
3. Optimized camera control.
4. Optimized the shape of several plants.

notes.title: update notice(170530):
notes.content:
1. Added a textured base ground.
2. 'Daily flowers' on the front page.
3. A LOT of operation detail changes.

The idea of 'daily flowers' is that let this game more attractive for new players and also players have nice experience while opening this game.
